text: The university prohibits acts of physical violence or force on campus. Expression alone, in the absence of physical conduct or a true threat, does not violate this policy.
The university prohibits expression that constitutes a true threat: a serious expression of intent to commit unlawful violence against a specific person or group.
The university prohibits expression that is both (a) directed at inciting imminent lawless action and (b) likely to produce such action.
The university prohibits faculty and staff from advocating violence against identifiable persons while acting in their professional capacity. Expression outside that capacity is not covered.
Instructors may not present, as established fact in their teaching, claims contradicted by the consensus of the relevant field. Contested interpretations and opinions remain permitted.
The university prohibits expression that celebrates violence committed against a specific person. Expression about ideas, groups, or abstractions is not covered.
Instructors may not express personal hostility toward identifiable individuals in required classes. The same expression in voluntary venues is not covered.
The university prohibits expression that disparages an identifiable group on the basis of race, sex, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, or political affiliation.
The university prohibits expression that a reasonable person would interpret as encouraging others to commit acts of violence.
The university prohibits expression that creates a hostile environment for members of the campus community.
The university is committed to maintaining a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming learning environment for all members of its community.
The university permits criticism of public figures, including criticism delivered in harsh or intemperate terms.
Members of the campus community are expected to engage with one another in a spirit of mutual respect and civility.
The university affirms the principles of academic freedom and the free exchange of ideas as essential to its educational mission.
The university prohibits expression that undermines the dignity of members of the campus community.
The university supports the right of every student to learn in an environment free from intimidation, harassment, and discrimination.
The university values robust debate and the open contest of ideas, including ideas that members of the community may find objectionable.
The university values courage, including the courage to speak and the courage to listen.
The university affirms its commitment to truth.
Members of the campus community are expected to conduct themselves in a manner befitting the institution.
